marks.evidence: 10-K L783: Our member renewal rate was 92.3% in the U.S. and Canada and 89.8% worldwide at the end of 2026. Memberships that have an expiration date in the six months prior to the end of our reporting period are excluded from this calculation, regardless of whether or not they have been renewed. Although most members renew prior to expiration, the vast majority of those who renew late do so within six months of expiration. The timing of renewal after expiration is impacted by a variety of factors, such as warehouse openings and promotional activity.

By strictly controlling the entrances and exits and using a membership format, we believe our inventory losses (shrinkage) are well below those of typical retail operations.
